WITH w AS ( INSERT INTO issn_link (issn, issn_l) SELECT DISTINCT ON (issn) issn, issn_l FROM issn_link_load ORDER BY issn, issn_l ON CONFLICT (issn) DO UPDATE SET issn_l = EXCLUDED.issn_l WHERE issn_link.issn_l IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.issn_l RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM w
